targetTexts.1: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
targetTexts.2: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
targetTexts.3: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
targetTexts.4: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
targetTexts.5: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
targetTexts.6: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
targetTexts.7: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
targetTexts.8: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
targetTexts.9: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
targetTexts.10: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
targetTexts.11: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
targetTexts.12: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
targetTexts.13: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
targetTexts.14: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
targetTexts.15: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
targetTexts.16: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
targetTexts.17: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
targetTexts.18: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
targetTexts.19: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
targetTexts.20: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
targetTexts.21: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
targetTexts.22: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
targetTexts.23: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
targetTexts.24: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
targetTexts.25: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
targetTexts.26: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
targetTexts.27: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
targetTexts.28: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
targetTexts.29: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
targetTexts.30: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
targetTexts.31: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
targetTexts.32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
targetTexts.33: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
targetTexts.34: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
targetTexts.35: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
